correctness.rationale: The branch equations give \(xy=a(a-1)\) and \(\lambda=1/[a^2(a-1)]\). Exact substitution into the published two-step Markov eigenvalue and disagreement-coefficient formulas yields \(s_2=\kappa=(a-1)^2\). The hard-core theorem \(\gamma\le\lambda/(1+\lambda)\) gives \(9\kappa\gamma\le F(t)\), where \(F(t)=9t^2/[1+t(1+t)^2]\) is strictly increasing on \(0<t<1/3\) and has endpoint value \(27/43<1\). All endpoint exclusions are explicit; finite checks are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The reconstruction product \(\kappa\gamma\) is the quantity used to certify extremality of the periodic phases. The exact collapse \(s_2=\kappa=(a-1)^2\) and uniform margin \(9\kappa\gamma<27/43\) replace a graphical monotonicity step with a global closed-form certificate and quantify the distance from the sufficient threshold across the whole branch.
